category_title: Struggling students using infinite practice for mastery
minimal_context: The student is working on self-paced math exercises in a computer lab to master a procedure.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please continue working on your math exercises on the computer. Remember, you need to get five in a row correct.

STUDENT: I just got that one wrong. I'm going to try the exact same strategy on this next problem and see if it works this time.

TUTOR: Okay, go ahead and try the next one.

STUDENT: It marked it wrong again. I tried asking my partner for help, but we have unique problems on our screens so we have to work through the procedure together instead of just sharing the solution.

TUTOR: Why don't you try watching the video lesson on the screen?

STUDENT: The teacher can teach me more than the video. I've just been repeating the same strategy for the last few problems and getting them all wrong, so I need you to come over here and help me.

options.A: Deliver verbal statements or gestures indicating approval beyond simple acknowledgment.
options.B: Go from student to student answering questions or providing support.
options.C: Withhold attention from the student during the computer lab session.
options.D: Provide a clear beginning and end for each math exercise in the session.
